connector.name: Crawleo MCP
connector.registryDescription: Hosted Crawleo MCP (remote streamable HTTP endpoint).
connector.summary: Hosted at api.crawleo.dev over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the crawleo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
